criteria.requirement: Add image_density=None opt-in selection to actual img conversion, not a standalone unused parser. For finite positive nonbool numeric targets, parse unordered x-density srcset candidates (unmarked means 1x), select the smallest density >= target or largest available, and resolve through existing baseurl/link behavior. Permit missing src when srcset is sufficient. Explicitly reject duplicate/nonpositive/nonfinite/malformed/mixed w descriptors; document data: sets containing ambiguous commas as unsupported and retain src. Default None uses src unchanged, images_to_alt/ignore_images bypass unused source parsing, and HTML-image output uses the chosen source. Do not fetch resources or infer CSS layout.

comparison: 依据真实程序行为接受等价实现，不按参考文本或篇幅评分。
